findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_scene, create_project, check_job, add_account_token, flow_status, list_live_models, list_available_llm · Private data: generate_image, music_download, generate_voice, check_job, fetch_media, add_account_token, flow_status, flow_health · Public sink: generate_scene, generate_character_image, create_character_from_photo, set_character_voice, add_account_token, flow_status, list_live_models, list_available_llm · Destructive: generate_image, music_chat, generate_scene, extend_video, generate_character_image, create_character_from_photo, generate_character_turnaround, add_account_token, flow_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_scene, create_project, check_job, add_account_token, flow_status, list_live_models, list_available_llm · Private data: generate_image, music_download, generate_voice, check_job, fetch_media, add_account_token, flow_status, flow_health · Public sink: generate_scene, generate_character_image, create_character_from_photo, set_character_voice, add_account_token, flow_status, list_live_models, list_available_llm · Destructive: generate_image, music_chat, generate_scene, extend_video, generate_character_image, create_character_from_photo, generate_character_turnaround, add_account_token, flow_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
